capabilities: Apply Markdown formatting (bold, headings, lists, callouts, links, code) from a toolbar
Position the toolbar fixed, near the selection, near the cursor, or dragged manually
Customize toolbar buttons, separators, and ordering in settings
Apply toolbar presets such as Writer, Zettelkasten, Code notes, and Compact
extras: README states community plugin submission was in progress; until accepted, install via BRAT or GitHub releases. Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
intentEvidence: clean-room Obsidian Markdown toolbar inspired by cMenu
problem: Formatting in Obsidian means command-palette trips or memorized shortcuts; this adds a direct-manipulation toolbar while notes stay plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: mdMenu is inspired by cMenu, an earlier Obsidian formatting toolbar plugin.

summary: Mini WYSIWYG-style Markdown formatting toolbar that applies headings, lists, callouts, links, and inline styles near the text being edited.
